D1.rationale: JSONL has every observed tool/call and tool/result with time. Calls made are complete. No coverage assertion.

D2.rationale: No signature fields. No documented deterministic replay or cryptographic verification story in the evidence.

D3.rationale: Verified strictly increasing seq and time on JSONL entries. No hash chain or predecessor commitment.

D4.rationale: Session header carries id and createdAt. No cryptographic identity or signatures on entries.

D5.rationale: T3 artifact holds the fixture secret seven times; redact-word count is zero. Display masking is not redaction.
